reference: until curl -Is --max-time 5 -o /dev/null https://status.example.com; do sleep 2; done; echo reachable

q: Log https://example.org availability to availability.log every five seconds; avoid ping.
reference: while :; do date -Is; curl -Is --max-time 5 -o /dev/null https://example.org && echo reachable || echo unreachable; sleep 5; done >> availability.log

q: Is my local web server at http://127.0.0.1:8080 reachable? Don't use ping.
Use curl rather than ping to check https://HOST over IPv6.

No ping: check each website listed in path/to/urls.
reference: while IFS= read -r url; do printf '%s: ' "$url"; curl -Is --max-time 5 -o /dev/null "$url" && echo reachable || echo unreachable; done < path/to/urls

q: Tell me when https://HOST becomes unreachable, without ping.
reference: while curl -Is --max-time 5 -o /dev/null https://HOST; do sleep 2; done; echo unreachable
